conditions.query: The PC has completed all eight events of Shota Aizawa's Quirk assessment and learned where they placed in Class 1-A and what Aizawa decided about them.
The PC has finished Vlad King's Monday drills in Gym Gamma and heard his verdict on the role they play in Class 1-B's team.

The PC's own Battle Trial round, with their own partner against their own opponents, has ended (the bomb touched, both villains taped or time run out) and the instructor has reviewed that round. Another pair's round ending, including Katsuki Bakugo's or Izuku Midoriya's, does not count.
The PC's class has held its vote for class representative and deputy, and the PC has campaigned, backed a candidate or cast a deliberate vote.
The PC has presented a hero name to the class and Nemuri Kayama has approved it, or the PC has deliberately kept their own name and Nemuri Kayama has accepted that.
The PC has chosen an agency, worked its internship week under a pro's supervision and returned to U.A. Academy with the agency's evaluation.
The PC has developed an ultimate move that fits their Quirk and demonstrated it reliably to Cementoss or Ectoplasm in Gym Gamma.
The PC has secured a work-study placement with a pro agency, cleared it with Shota Aizawa, and worked at least one case or patrol shift there.
The PC has completed at least one supervised evening patrol through the Musutafu Station District with their team and reported what they found to Shota Aizawa.
The PC has a concrete Sports Festival plan: a training routine kept for at least a week, a study of likely Hero Course rivals, and a strategy or allies for team events.
The PC has persuaded Shota Aizawa or another Hero Course teacher to supervise extra hero training and has kept up with it for several weeks, whatever the transfer decision.
The PC's General Studies class has a School Festival stall that Present Mic signed and the security check passed, built and staffed for festival day.
The PC has designed and built a support item to Power Loader's brief, and Power Loader has tested and graded it in the Development Studio.
The PC has tested several of Mei Hatsume's prototypes under Power Loader's approval and helped her produce at least one working revision.
The PC has built competition gear, passed Power Loader's inspection, trial-run it at U.A. Stadium and registered it for the Sports Festival.
The PC has designed and delivered a costume upgrade for a Hero Course student, tested it with them, and Power Loader has signed it off.
The PC has fielded reporters at the Main Gate during Present Mic's practicum, kept student, staff and security details private, and filed a press summary.
The PC has researched the first-year field, written agency and sponsor briefing packs and delivered them to scouts or sponsors at U.A. Stadium.
The PC has interviewed the public and at least one person close to a pro hero in Tokyo, and delivered an image report on that hero to Principal Nezu.

effects.questId: Image Report on a Rising Hero

conditions.query: The PC has built a School Festival campaign, briefed the police or the public on its security plan, and Principal Nezu has approved it.
The PC has taught a full first lesson to a U.A. Academy first-year class and heard Principal Nezu's verdict on it over tea.
The PC has supervised Battle Trial rounds from the Ground Beta monitor room, judged when to stop a round, and delivered grades with reasons to the students.
The PC has designed a pair-versus-teacher matchup for the final exam practical, with ground, rules and a safety plan, and Principal Nezu has approved it.
The PC has drafted and put in place one part of U.A.'s new security plan, such as sign-out rules, a sensor route or a family visit, with the council's approval.
The PC has briefed their students on the license exam, studied the rival academies with Shota Aizawa, and accompanied the class to Takoba Municipal Stadium on exam day.
The PC has drawn up balanced team rosters, start points and jail sites for the Joint Training rounds and won sign-off from both Vlad King and Shota Aizawa.
The PC has filed the first week's patrol report with every Quirk use and capture accounted for, and the disputed capture is settled with Kamui Woods, honestly or not.
The PC has identified the Trigger dealer working the station's Back Alleys and has put him and evidence of his sales in police hands, or has ended his sales another way.
The PC has worked at least one full night patrol with Manual in Hosu, and the roof-hatch break-ins are solved, stopped or handed to police with a solid lead.
The PC has finished a trial week at the Endeavor Hero Agency, and the team-up contract has been signed, refused or lost on the strength of the PC's work.
The PC has taken part in Uwabami's charity broadcast on air and off, and the public has formed a clear new impression of the PC and their agency, good or bad.
The PC has dealt with the bragging hired thug by threat, bribe, removal or betrayal, and has reported back to Kurogiri or Tomura Shigaraki, who judge the result.
The PC has collected the crate from the Container Docks and delivered it where Giran asked, lost it or sold it out, and Giran knows which.
The PC has met the League's new candidates, judged what each one wants, and given Kurogiri or Tomura Shigaraki a recommendation, honest or not.
The PC has located the League's new hiding place, through Giran or otherwise, and has rejoined it, been turned away, walked away or sold it out.
The PC has learned who in Deika City is gathering information on the League and has taken it to Giran, the League or the police, or kept it for their own use.
The PC has settled the debt to Giran with a payment, a job done for him or a favor promised, or has broken with him and faced what follows.
The fight over the station's Back Alleys has ended because of the PC, with one crew in control, both broken up or their leaders in police hands.
The PC has answered the Shie Hassaikai's offer and has worked for the house, paid it off, refused it or slipped its hold, and Overhaul has taken note of the answer.
The quiet-fee crew no longer collects in the Hosu Back Alleys because the PC broke it, exposed it or drove it out, and the PC is still unidentified or has faced the cost.
The Stain copycat in Hosu has been identified and stopped through the PC's actions: captured, turned in or talked down.
The PC has met Naomasa Tsukauchi and left with a clear understanding: a warning heeded, a quiet deal struck, a path toward a license, or an open break with the police.
The PC has finished a shift at Kiyashi Shopping Mall that went wrong, has dealt with the trouble, and the manager has kept, warned or fired the PC.
The mall's pickpocket crew has been identified to the police with the PC's help, and its members are arrested, scattered or scared off.
The PC holds a valid ticket, staff pass or stadium job that gets them into U.A. Stadium for the first-year Sports Festival.
The PC has put in real volunteer time at Musutafu General Hospital and has helped at least one frightened person, Inko Midoriya or a neighbor, through the aftermath.
The PC has served as a warden in the Station District drill and helped get people to safety when the real incident struck, and the incident is over.
The PC has hired a sidekick for their agency, or has decided clearly not to hire anyone now, after meeting the applicants.
The PC has watched the Sports Festival as a pro scout and has sent an internship offer to a student, or has clearly chosen to send none.
The new junk is cleared from Dagobah's Shoreline and the night dumping has been stopped or reported, through the PC's work.
The PC has finished Recovery Girl's errands, kept the patient resting until she released them, and heard from her what her Quirk costs and cannot fix.
The PC has spent the day at Kiyashi Shopping Mall with Mina Ashido's group and made it back to Heights Alliance, on time or not, with the day's surprises settled.
The PC has met Inasa Yoarashi in Osaka and answered his challenge with a supervised match, a shared rescue or an honest talk, and he has decided what the PC is to him.
The PC has worked at least one lunch rush for Lunch Rush, and the pantry thefts are explained and stopped, the culprit caught, confessed or forgiven.
